title: 外国人不能买地？：菲律宾新规，租期99年
speaker: Ralph Recto

segments.en: Income classification. We're now on upper middle income category country. In the last time we were there was... we got classified was a few decades back.
segments.zh: 收入分类上，我们现在已跻身中高收入国家行列。上一次我们达到这个水平，还是几十年前。

segments.en: And of course this is good for us. It reinforces investor confidence in our economy and also is confirmation that the reforms that this administration and administrations in the past have been doing are the right reforms, the right steps to improve the economy.
segments.zh: 这当然对我们有利，增强了市场对我们经济的信心，也印证了本届及历届政府推进的改革方向正确、步骤得当，有助于经济持续向好。

segments.en: We have also in the first half of the Marcos administration, we have actually come up with many reforms that are really meant to improve and make the Philippines the most conducive and accessible investment environment it has been in Philippine history.
segments.zh: 在马科斯政府上半段，我们推出了多项改革，旨在把菲律宾打造成历史上最具吸引力、最便利的市场准入环境。

segments.en: If you'll allow me, I'll name six. The first one was the CREATE MORE Act, where we give financial incentives to investors of up to 40 years: income tax holidays, reduced income taxes.
segments.zh: 我列举六项：第一是CREATE MORE法案，为投资者提供长达40年的财税激励，包括所得税减免等。

segments.en: Second, we passed the Public-Private Partnership Code. Proof of that is we privatized three airports in the Philippines in the first half of this administration: one in Luzon, one in Visayas, and one in Mindanao.
segments.zh: 第二，我们通过了公私合作法案。佐证是本届政府上半段已私有化三座机场，分别位于吕宋、维萨亚和棉兰老。

segments.en: Third is we passed the 99-year land lease act, which allows... Constitutionally, foreigners cannot own land in the Philippines, but now with the 99-year land lease act, foreigners can now lease land long-term in the Philippines, which is the gold standard in Asia: 99-year land leases.
segments.zh: 第三，我们通过了99年土地租赁法案。宪法规定外国人不能拥有菲律宾土地，但现在通过该法案，外国人可长期租赁土地，这堪称亚洲的黄金标准。

segments.en: Fourth, we also passed the Accelerated Right-of-Way Act, which is meant to speed up infrastructure projects in the Philippines. Fifth, we also passed the Mining Fiscal Regime Act, which restores predictability in the exploration and processing of critical minerals, green minerals in the Philippines.
segments.zh: 第四，我们通过了加速路权法案，以加快基础设施项目。第五，我们通过了矿业财政制度法案，恢复了关键矿产和绿色矿产勘探加工的可预期性。

segments.en: And lastly, the executive order on the green lanes for strategic investments, which is meant to streamline and fast-track investment approvals. So I think the most important message is that we've undertaken all these reforms to make the Philippines the most open and liberal investment climate it has ever been.
segments.zh: 最后，我们发布了战略投资绿色通道行政令，旨在简化和加速审批。最重要的信息是，我们通过这些改革，使菲律宾的市场环境达到史上最开放、最自由的水平。
